title: Method of Moments Estimation of High-Dimensional Covariance Using a Parametric Model
summary: We propose method-of-moments estimators for the eigenvalues of variance component covariance matrices in multivariate mixed effects models. Assuming a parametric form for the eigenvalue distribution, we focus on the high-dimensional regime where the number of predictors is large and comparable to the number of realizations of each random effect. In this setting, we show that the empirical moments of sum-of-squares matrices (e.g., MANOVA estimators of the covariance matrices) can be closely approximated by deterministic functions of the underlying parameters.
